newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil firms, fuel oil dips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil firms, fuel oil dips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with gas oil futures rising, but fuel oil barges dipping, dealers said.

Heating oil barges were $1/$2 a tonne firmer as gas oil futures rose. Premiums were unchanged with offers at IPE March +$2 fob ARA for prompt and first half March. Traders said there were no signs of buyers as mild weather continued in continental Europe.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were $1/$2 lower than at Friday's close. Offers were at $100, with bids at $98
